comments.author: Slight_Butterfly_603
comments.body:
I do not, but It doesn't look bad. it has direct links to popular apps, it uses suno and allows you to try 5.5 which not even suno does for music, the price is too high though. 

I did use [pixelab.ai](http://pixelab.ai) and ran an analysis on it. It is worth paying and using because it has 2 filters that help the pixel art output and has some different modes and tools that can be very useful for 2d pixel art compared to just google nano banana or other art ai apps.

  
Overall, it has sort of everything in there but what you would want costs $ per usage through API and you can just do that for cheaper using the direct tools, but it's other tools you one time pay for COULD be useful, depends on person to person but you could also just have claude build them but it might take some time to debug and you have to pay for claude.

comments.author: RelielNinja
comments.body:
When Fable first dropped I asked it to take a look at a handful of AI tools like this, pixellab.ai, and a few others to kind of review their legitimacy, overall value, etc. With Sorceress, it has a few neat tools that are genuinely useful, but found half of them buildable myself with just claude/chatgpt, though mine were limited (mainly due to not wanting to manage costs across various models) and this has access to multiple AI's to test different outputs, but really that's the main thing you are paying for (and was not really worth it after my full eval). Neat suite of tools for sure and hope the dev sees some success with it. 
That said, I'd maybe poke around the site and see what tools seem genuinely useful to you specifically and determine if they are possible to build for your personal use.
